recipe.visualDefinition: A soft-focus male portrait with a distinct 1980s R&B aesthetic, characterized by a blue-to-lavender gradient background, visible halftone dot patterns in the shadows, and thin geometric vector lines intersecting the composition.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's dark suit contrasting against a luminous, hazy blue aura
Thin, vibrant geometric lines cutting across the soft-focus photography
Italicized typography following the diagonal movement of the graphic lines
coreInvariants: Halftone dot texture in mid-tones and shadows
Soft-glow 'aura' effect around the subject's silhouette
High-key white shirt/cravat as a central brightness anchor

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up, subject centered horizontally but slightly angled, filling the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and white neckwear provide the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the subject's face upward to the top-right typography, guided by the diagonal graphic lines.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample breathing room in the upper third for display text, rendered in a soft gradient.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cobalt and powder blue gradients forming the atmosphere.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep navy and black tones in the suit, textured with halftone dots.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Thin orange and yellow geometric lines providing a sharp color break.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value in the center (white shirt) tapering into saturated blues and dark, textured shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid harsh blacks; use deep navy halftone instead
Limit to cool blues, purples, and warm accent lines

characterSpecificRedesigns: None; relies on clean, modernistic geometric forms

composition.position: Upper right quadrant, below primary text

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used with varying weights and rotations.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric 80s aesthetic and sharp terminals.
Captures the era's preference for geometric circular counters.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus studio portrait of a man in a dark suit and white cravat against a blue-lavender gradient background. Apply a subtle halftone dot texture to the shadows and a soft glow effect around the subject. Include three thin, sharp diagonal lines (orange, yellow, and green) intersecting the top half.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase text in a bold geometric sans-serif italic. Place the primary name at the top right with wide tracking. Place the secondary title below it, rotated 15 degrees to match the diagonal lines.

verificationChecks: Is the halftone pattern visible in the suit shadows?
Is the text slanted and tracked widely?
Are the geometric lines thin and sharp compared to the soft portrait?
Is the color palette restricted to blues, purples, and white?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the halftone dot pattern
Angle of the diagonal text and lines
Saturation of the blue background gradient
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or faces
postGenerationChecks: Ensure typography is perfectly legible against the gradient
Check that the halftone dots do not obscure facial features
Verify the diagonal lines feel like graphic overlays, not physical objects
Confirm the 'aura' glow is smooth and not pixelated
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine soft-focus portraiture + halftone shadow textures + geometric sans-serif italics + thin vector line accents.
